name: Garmin Ride · November 15, 2026
description: Experimental terrain interpretation. Segments complete by distance traveled on the bike. Duration is an estimate; elapsed time does not advance the route. First and final easy sections serve as warmup and cooldown. Power zones require your rider profile; resistance is adjusted to meet power/cadence, not inferred from road grade. Short hills may be smoothed out. Review targets before riding.

source.method: 100 m elevation samples, five-point smoothing, approximately 1 km sections; grade thresholds -1%, 1.5%, 5%
